id: title:eleftheriatrivyzaki:prevent browser translate dom crash on login and 2fa

review.posthog_relevance: Frontend authentication UI stability and accessibility. The changes wrap bare text nodes in `<span>` elements to prevent React runtime crashes caused by in-page translation replacing text nodes with unsupported `<font>` elements. This preserves the authentication flow, preventing users from being blocked during login, and ensures compatibility with translation tools.
